equation.label: definition of the exponential function
equation.formula: $$f(x) = b^{x}\text{,~~where~~}b > 0,~b \neq 1$$

equation.label: definition of exponential growth
equation.formula: $$f(x) = ab^{x},\mspace{9mu}\text{where~}a > 0,\operatorname{}b > 0,\operatorname{}b \neq 1$$

equation.label: compound interest formula
equation.formula: $$\begin{array}{l} {A(t) = P\left( {1 + \frac{r}{n}} \right)^{nt}~,\mspace{9mu}\text{where}} \\ {A(t)\mspace{9mu}\text{is~the~account~value~at~time~}t} \\ {t\mspace{9mu}\text{is~the~number~of~years}} \\ {P\mspace{9mu}\text{is~the~initial~investment,~often~called~the~principal}} \\ {r\mspace{9mu}\text{is~the~annual~percentage~rate~(APR),~or~nominal~rate}} \\ {n\mspace{9mu}\text{is~the~number~of~compounding~periods~in~one~year}} \end{array}$$

equation.label: continuous growth formula
equation.formula: $$A(t) = ae^{rt},\mspace{9mu}\text{where}$$ $$t$$ is the number of unit time periods of growth $$a$$ is the starting amount (in the continuous compounding formula a is replaced with P, the principal) $$e$$ is the mathematical constant, $$e \approx 2.718282$$

Definition of the logarithmic function
equation.formula: For $$~x > 0,b > 0,b \neq 1,$$ $$y = \log_{b}(x)$$ if and only if $$b^{y} = x.$$

equation.label: Definition of the common logarithm
equation.formula: For $$x > 0,$$ $$y = \log(x)$$ if and only if $$10^{y} = x.$$

equation.label: Definition of the natural logarithm
equation.formula: For $$x > 0,$$ $$y = \ln(x)$$ if and only if $$e^{y} = x.$$

equation.label: General Form for the Translation of the Parent Logarithmic Functionf(x)=logb(x)f(x)=logb(x)
equation.formula: $$~f(x) = a\log_{b}\left( {x + c} \right) + d$$

equation.label: The Product Rule for Logarithms
equation.formula: $$\log_{b}(MN) = \log_{b}(M) + \log_{b}(N)$$

equation.label: The Quotient Rule for Logarithms
equation.formula: $$\log_{b}\left( \frac{M}{N} \right) = \log_{b}M - \log_{b}N$$

equation.label: The Power Rule for Logarithms
equation.formula: $$\log_{b}\left( M^{n} \right) = n\log_{b}M$$

equation.label: The Change-of-Base Formula
equation.formula: $$\log_{b}M\text{=}\frac{\log_{n}M}{\log_{n}b}\mspace{9mu}\text{~~~~~~~~}n > 0,n \neq 1,b \neq 1$$

equation.label: One-to-one property for exponential functions
equation.formula: For any algebraic expressions $$S$$ and $$T$$ and any positive real number $$b,$$ where $$b^{S} = b^{T}$$ if and only if $$S = T.$$

equation.label: Definition of a logarithm
equation.formula: For any algebraic expression S and positive real numbers $$b~$$ and $$c,$$ where $$b \neq 1,$$ $$\log_{b}(S) = c$$ if and only if $$b^{c} = S.$$

equation.label: One-to-one property for logarithmic functions
equation.formula: For any algebraic expressions S and T and any positive real number $$b,$$ where $$b \neq 1,$$ $$\log_{b}S = \log_{b}T$$ if and only if $$S = T.$$

equation.label: Half-life formula
equation.formula: If $$A = A_{0}e^{kt},$$ $$k < 0,$$ the half-life is $$t = - \frac{\ln(2)}{k}.$$

equation.label: Carbon-14 dating
equation.formula: $$t = \frac{\ln\left( \frac{A}{A_{0}} \right)}{- 0.000121}.$$ $$A_{0}$$ is the amount of carbon-14 when the plant or animal died $$A$$ is the amount of carbon-14 remaining today $$t$$ is the age of the fossil in years

equation.label: Doubling time formula
equation.formula: If $$A = A_{0}e^{kt},$$ $$k > 0,$$ the doubling time is $$t = \frac{\ln 2}{k}$$

equation.label: Newton’s Law of Cooling
equation.formula: $$T(t) = Ae^{kt} + T_{s},$$ where $$T_{s}$$ is the ambient temperature, $$A = T(0) - T_{s},$$ and $$k$$ is the continuous rate of cooling.
